decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Location Plan, PD/2, PD/3, PD/23, PD/13 rev A, PD/4 received 07/03/2012; PD/21 rev A, PD/22 rev A received 16/04/2012; and PD/20 A received 18/06/12) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension, construction of a rear roof extension, replacement of existing aluminium windows with u PVC windows and a single storey extension to the existing separate garage at the rear of the site.
